get.description: Everything a manual-entry form needs, taken from the registry the ingest pipeline uses.

post.description:
Record one reading typed in by a person (source kind `manual`).

A reading that fails validation is still stored, marked rejected with its reasons and
audited, exactly as for sensor data: the response then says why.

get.description: Most recently entered manual readings first, rejected ones included (with reasons).

schema.title: Response List Manual Entries Api V1 Manual Entries Get

get.description:
Daily and running sums of logged dosimeter doses.

Arithmetic only: AM records what the dosimeter reported and adds it up. It does not
compare doses with any exposure limit.

schema.title: Response List Missions Api V1 Missions Get

post.description:
Create a mission; it becomes the astronaut's current mission (day 1 = start date, UTC).

A mission on a simulated crew record is marked simulated too, so generated and real
records never mix.

get.description:
Return a package file (the JSON by default; `file` selects another file of the package).

The download is audited. The person's name comes from the X-AM-Actor header,
percent-encoded UTF-8, so it stays out of URLs and server access logs.
The most serious open item (alert or active symptom) and the guidance for its level.
